name: d1_planner
description: LIBRARY LAYER (adoption-scored): factorization planner on a split-complex Stockham core (true-zmm noinline kernels; 2/3/4/5/8 + radix-16/64 L1-tile stages + generic prime<=61 stage; paired-p zmm s=4 kernels at 3/8/16/64) -- direct smooth / unpadded Rader (smooth L-1) / smooth-padded Bluestein, both with the fused fwd-last x kernel x inv-entry mid pass; big-M Bluestein (100003 -> 204800 = 8192x25) via d1_bluestein's Agarwal-Cooley coprime 2D conv (CRT, no inter-axis twiddles; chirp/CRT-fused entry+exit, NT-streamed exit scatter, stmid8 row middles, chain map+chirp fused into the CRT scatter); TILE EXITS st{16,64}_last_{int,map} make the tile the final stage: 4096=[4,64,16] and 16384=[4,64,64] run 3 passes (conv rows keep 2/4 tails for the mid/exit fusions); every chain step fuses map(z+c) into its final stage (split, zero-shuffle; Rader conv-order chain included via the swapped-plane st4_last_map_rader), lane chains on 2-pass chain-only schedules (64=[8,8], 128=[16,8]); Goldschmidt + early-seeded-rcp map everywhere; whole-2MB-page pre-faulted arena; Rader gather T0 (batch>=2) + scatter ET0 prefetch; adopted codelets: d1_prime 13/31, d1_pow2 32/64, d1_composite PFA-60 (B<8 chain tail); NT fused exits above L3 incl. the tile exits
